subject.title: feat: per-model code-mode capability flags with an "auto" master-switch tier

question: Should OpenClaw add `tools.codeMode: "auto"` as a supported long-term configuration tier whose behavior is controlled by provider-owned `compat.codeMode` catalog metadata?
rationale: This is a new configuration and catalog contract rather than a repair of an established behavior; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the permanent user-facing product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve the auto-tier contract
options.body: Keep the default off, document the provider-owned catalog semantics, and require the requested live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the boolean-only setting
options.body: Decline the new configuration surface and retain explicit global enablement until a narrower owner-approved design is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve the auto-tier contract
recommendation.body: Keep the default off, document the provider-owned catalog semantics, and require the requested live proof before merge.
